python/mirage/utils/generated/iconv_data.py and
typescript/packages/core/src/utils/generated/iconv_data.ts are generated by
scripts/gen_iconv_multibyte.py from the mapping tables iconv's multi-byte
charsets follow: the Unicode Consortium's JIS0201.TXT, JIS0208.TXT and
JIS0212.TXT (https://www.unicode.org/Public/MAPPINGS/OBSOLETE/EASTASIA/JIS/),
its GB2312.TXT of 1999, since withdrawn, Microsoft's CP936.TXT as the
Consortium publishes it
(https://www.unicode.org/Public/MAPPINGS/VENDORS/MICSFT/WINDOWS/), and the
indexes of the WHATWG Encoding Standard's multi-byte encodings, under the
notice whatwg-encoding.txt reproduces. The generated files hold where each
table differs from what a host's own decoder answers. The JIS tables and
CP936.TXT are under the Unicode terms of use
(https://www.unicode.org/terms_of_use.html: for data files, the Unicode
License V3 that unicode-data.txt reproduces), and GB2312.TXT carries this
notice:

Copyright (c) 1991-1999 Unicode, Inc. All Rights reserved.

This file is provided as-is by Unicode, Inc. (The Unicode Consortium). No
claims are made as to fitness for any particular purpose. No warranties of
any kind are expressed or implied. The recipient agrees to determine
applicability of information provided. If this file has been provided on
optical media by Unicode, Inc., the sole remedy for any claim will be
exchange of defective media within 90 days of receipt.

Unicode, Inc. hereby grants the right to freely use the information supplied
in this file in the creation of products supporting the Unicode Standard,
and to make copies of this file in any form for internal or external
distribution as long as this notice remains attached.
